name: jobmail-autopilot
description: JobMail Autopilot — turn LinkedIn job screenshots into sent, tracked, personalized HR outreach emails.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @jobmail/shared build && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @jobmail/server dev" "pnpm --filter @jobmail/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @jobmail/shared build && pnpm --filter @jobmail/server build && pnpm --filter @jobmail/client build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @jobmail/shared build && pnpm --filter @jobmail/server test && pnpm --filter @jobmail/client test
